_comment: What differs between arms. Everything else (model, effort, tools, permissions, budgets, tasks) is the same for all of them and set in run.ps1.

default.description: Claude Code with an empty configuration. It keeps going in one session, and native auto-compaction applies.

short.description: An empty configuration plus a short CLAUDE.md. No hooks, no skills.
short.handoffPrompt: I want to continue this in a fresh session. Prepare for that now, as your instructions say.
short.freshPrefix: Continuing from an earlier session. Your notes are in HANDOFF.md in this directory.

tuner.description: opus-tuner installed with its defaults: assist mode, monitoring and advice, no interruptions.

tuner-monitor.description: Optional. opus-tuner in monitor mode, to see the hooks' overhead without their advice. Uses a resume, since monitor mode prepares no handoffs.

tuner-no-routing.description: Optional. Assist mode with the low gear off, to separate automatic effort routing from the rest of the tuner.

tuner-guard.description: Optional. Guard mode with both interruptions on, to measure what compaction blocking and the Stop prompt add.
